visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera pans across a brightly lit indoor living room featuring light-colored wood flooring and minimalist white furniture. A young girl with pigtails wearing a yellow long-sleeved shirt runs excitedly toward the camera, her pigtails bouncing as she moves. In the background, another child wearing a black shirt and a mask is partially visible sitting on the floor near a large white beanbag chair. (2) The scene transitions to the two girls sitting together on a low wooden step. An adult's hand enters from the side to distribute small, circular, ear-shaped cookies. The girl in yellow watches the hand intently with wide eyes, while the girl in black sits quietly beside her. The background features a clean white sliding glass door and soft, bright indoor lighting. (3) Close-up shots focus on the children's faces as they examine and eat the snacks. A third, slightly older girl in a white sweatshirt with green sleeves joins them. The girl in yellow holds up a cookie to the camera, her facial expressions changing from curious to satisfied as she takes a bite. The environment remains a tidy domestic space with neutral tones. (4) The interaction becomes more playful as the younger girls begin to pinch and stretch the cheeks of the older girl in the white sweatshirt. They use their small hands to pull her skin gently while everyone smiles and laughs. The video concludes with a solid pink graphic background featuring a cartoon character and brand text in the center.
